messages:
maria: Heads up — starting ~09:00 PT a number of inference jobs in us-west2 entered a "collective progress" stuck state after the NCCL 3.2.1 rollout. Latency spiked, some requests never completed until node reboot.
kevin: Which fleet/pool? hosted or dedicated?
maria: Dedicated A100 pool (uw2-dedicated-a100). Topology is mixed NVLink & PCIe racks. Noticed p2p errors in dmesg on several hosts.
liam: Can you paste the dmesg excerpt? We rolled a kernel bump recently, trying to correlate.
maria: Here's a representative snippet from host-uw2-12:

```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1234.568123] nvidia 0000:65:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1234.568456] nvlink: link0: link flapping detected
[ 1234.569000] nccl: WARN AllReduce timed out after 2000 ms
```

kevin: Link flaps + GPU falloff — could be NVLink cable/firmware or driver mismatch. But timeline shows nccl 3.2.1 promotion as well?
alisha: Yes, we promoted nccl 3.2.1 in us-west2 at ~02:00. Kernel 6.1.21 landed on that pool around 01:30. Canary nodes with prior kernel didn't show stalls.
liam: Any NCCL trace logs or collectives plugin captures in the diagnostics bundle?
maria: Uploaded bundle to INFRA-4823. Core symptom: progress stalls for all-to-all / allreduce. Threads spin in p2p send/recv, no heavy CPU backlog.
kevin: Quick hypothesis: NCCL NVLink path is hitting flapping link handling more aggressively in 3.2.x, or kernel changed NVLink handling.
liam: Test suggestion: run repro with env overrides: NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS and NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL to see path difference. Also try NCCL_LAUNCH_MODE=GROUP.
maria: Ran repro on host-uw2-12: with NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS the allreduce completes; with NVL it hangs consistently.
kevin: That's a good signal. Points to nvlink path triggering the stall.
alisha: Driver on these hosts is 530.41, NVLink firmware 2.4.0. No firmware rollouts recently.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: rollback nccl 3.2.1 -> 3.1.7 on pool 'uw2-dedicated-a100' at 22:00 PT (manual approval required).
kevin: Approve rollback but gate it behind canary automated test that runs the allreduce repro. If canary looks good, do staged rollback.
alisha: Approved and scheduled. Will coordinate with on-call and eng-infra.
liam: Longer-term: 1) file upstream issue with NCCL maintainers including traces & dmesg; 2) add NVLink-heavy collective canary test post-upgrades; 3) consider temporary force to SYS p2p for certain topologies.
maria: INFRA-4823 created with repro steps and bundle. Also added temporary per-pool override to set NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS for uw2-dedicated-a100.
kevin: Notify affected customers with SLAs in us-west2 about potential short redeploy window during rollback. @ops-bot can you draft an incident note?
ops-bot: Drafted: "We observed stalls affecting multi-GPU inference in the us-west2 dedicated A100 pool after an NCCL upgrade. Rolling back on canary; short redeploy may occur tonight. Monitoring and updates to follow." :warning:

alisha: Post-rollback verification plan: run multi-node allreduce repro 10x then ramp prod traffic at reduced weight for 30m. If stable, continue staged rollout.
liam: Also add kernel 6.1.21 regression tests to the nccl promotion matrix. If kernel interaction is confirmed we should pin kernel for the pool until a tested path is available.
maria: Canary rollback first-run results: repro passed 20/20. Staged rollback scheduled for 22:00.
kevin: Assign follow-ups: maria -> update INFRA-4823 with results; alisha -> coordinate rollback; liam -> PR for NVLink canary harness.
maria: (22:45) Staged rollback complete. Canary + 50% of pool rolled back. No new stalls in last 30m. Monitoring ongoing.
liam: Good. Draft postmortem and include mitigation steps: rollback playbook, per-pool env override, canary test, and upstream issue.
maria: Drafting postmortem now.
kevin: Great job. We'll mark incident for 24h stability window then close. Keep kernel tests queued before we reattempt nccl 3.2.x.
support: Watching for customer tickets, will surface anything we see.
